title: Last Call
subtitle: progressive house anthem · the lights come on in major
statement: A pluck that grows for 32 bars, its filter opening by 1/φ of the remaining way every 8 bars. The handshake, sung by everything at once. The last chord turns minor into major.
intro: The last song of the night: everyone singing, and then the lights.

sections.name: Last Orders
sections.intent: Kick and hats for the mix; electric piano chords.

sections.name: Build
sections.intent: The pluck arpeggio enters and grows; bass at bar 25, clap at bar 33.
moves: Arp filter: 300 Hz → 6 kHz, each 8 bars 1/φ of the remaining way.

sections.name: Break
sections.intent: Kick out. Pads, piano and the lead stating the handshake slowly.

sections.name: Anthem
sections.intent: Supersaw chords, the lead, the arp and every drum.

sections.name: Lights On
sections.intent: Piano alone; the last chord is F-sharp major.

layers.name: Kick
layers.description: A round house kick tuned near F-sharp.
layers.purpose: The last heartbeat of the night.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, shaker

layers.name: Hats
layers.description: Metallic hats from six band-limited square oscillators (the 808 recipe): short closed ticks and off-beat open hats, almost no noise.
layers.purpose: The tick of the groove, kept small.

instrument.name: Drum kit
instrument.description: clap, hat, kick, open, ride, rim, shaker

layers.name: Electric piano
layers.description: FM electric piano: opens the track, carries the break, and plays the last chord, F-sharp major, rolled.
layers.purpose: The human hand that closes the night.

instrument.name: FM Electric Piano
instrument.description: Two-operator FM: a warm 1:1 body and a ratio-14 tine strike, with stereo tremolo.

layers.name: Pluck arp
layers.description: A pluck arpeggio on the chord tones, 16ths, the fourth of every group an octave up.

instrument.name: Pluck
instrument.description: Saw and square, a little detuned, with a fast filter snap and short decay.

layers.name: Bass
layers.description: Off-beat bass with a sub, on each chord's root. Since take 3 it rides above the warm bass, high-passed at 220 Hz: the bite and the talk, not the weight.

instrument.name: Mono Synth
instrument.description: Saw, square and sub oscillators, glide, vibrato and an enveloped resonant filter.

layers.name: Supersaw chords
layers.description: Wide supersaw chords, slow in the break and pumped hard by the kick in the anthem.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Anthem lead
layers.description: Supersaw lead: F-sharp, C-sharp, F-sharp, A (the handshake), then the line everyone sings.

instrument.name: Supersaw
instrument.description: Seven detuned saws per note, spread wide, through an enveloped low-pass.

layers.name: Synth choir
layers.description: A synth choir: four drifting, vibrato-ed saw singers per note through five choir formants, each chord walking its own vowels. No breath noise.
layers.purpose: Fills the top with voices instead of hiss.

instrument.name: Synth Choir
instrument.description: An ensemble of drifting, vibrato-ed saws per note through five choir formants; tones, no noise.

layers.name: Warm bass
layers.description: Moog-style: saw, detuned pulse and a triangle sub into an overdriven ladder, then tape warmth.
layers.purpose: The warm foundation: it owns everything below about 250 Hz.

instrument.name: Warm Bass (Moog-style)
instrument.description: Saw, detuned pulse and triangle sub into an overdriven ladder that follows the note, then tape warmth.

instrument.name: Transition FX
instrument.description: Noise risers, downlifters, impacts, crashes, reversed crashes and sub drops.

layers.name: Voice (close)
layers.description: Close and human: four in the morning, the anthem once softly in the break, and the last line on the major chord.
layers.purpose: The last song of the night.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Voice (anthem)
layers.description: The anthem lead's melody with words, an octave under the synth: sung with doubles, for everyone.

instrument.name: Electric Bat voice
instrument.description: The project's singing synthesizer: lyrics to phonemes, a human performance, autotune, then production.

layers.name: Robots
layers.description: A power core humming under the break, the album's handshake one last time, a major chord materialising as the lights come on, and a droid's lullaby.

instrument.name: Robot rack
instrument.description: Machines from the batsynth robot library (servos, droids, modems, coils, turbines, alarms, clocks).

lanes.name: arp filter (kHz)
lanes.description: The arp's low-pass, opening along the golden ratio.

lanes.name: tension (plan)
lanes.description: How tense each section is meant to feel.

motifs.how: the first four notes of the anthem

lyrics.text: Four o'clock and the floor is gold,
the speakers hum, the night is old,
and everyone is singing like they mean it,
I can't keep a single word,
so sing it like you mean it.
I can't keep a single word,
so sing it like you mean it.

lyrics_take4.text: It's four am, the floor is gold,
the speakers hum, the night is old,
and everyone is singing like they mean it,
When the lights come on tonight, I'll forget your face, and every night I'm born, and every night I fade.
When the lights come on tonight, I'll forget your face, and every night I'm born, and every night I fade.
Sing it while I'm here tonight, nothing stays when dawn comes, every word I sang you fades away in me.

Sing it while I'm here tonight, nothing stays when dawn comes, every word I sang you fades away in me.
